stem: The National American Woman Suffrage Association (NAWSA) was founded in 1890 under the leadership of Elizabeth Cady Stanton. What was the PRIMARY goal of this organization?

options.label: A
options.text: To provide women with a more active voice in government

options.label: B
options.text: To guarantee women would be appointed to public office

options.label: C
options.text: To provide women studying politics with college scholarships

options.label: D
options.text: To guarantee women would be able to donate money to political campaigns
